properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.url
properties.description: 连接URL

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.driver-class-name
properties.description: jdbc驱动类

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.username
properties.description: 数据库用户名

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.password
properties.description: 数据库用户口令

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.min-connections
properties.description: 池中最小连接数。取值范围 0 - 100，默认 1

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.max-connections
properties.description: 池中最大连接数。取值范围 1 - 1000，默认 10

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.idle-timeout-sec
properties.description: 连接最大空闲时间(单位：秒seconds)，空闲超过该时间的连接将被检测或回收。取值范围 10s - 3600s，默认 5 * 60s

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.checkout-timeout-millisec
properties.description: 等待空闲连接时的超时时间(单位：milliseconds)。<0 一直等待，直到有空闲连接(危险！如果程序有bug可能导致一直等待)；=0 不等待，立刻抛SQLException；最大值 600 * 1000ms，默认 10 * 1000ms

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.lifetime-sec
properties.description: 连接存活时间(单位：秒seconds)，存活超过这个时间的连接将被回收。<=0 不回收；最大值 24 * 3600s，默认：0 不回收

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.query-timeout
properties.description: query timeout (seconds)。<= 0 - no timeout，默认 60s

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.login-timeout
properties.description: default login timeout 10 seconds

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.check-statement
properties.description: 检测连接是否可用的查询语句。会根据数据库类型自动配置：oracle - select systimestamp from dual；mysql - select now()；db2 - values(current timestamp)

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.commit-on-close
properties.description: 关闭连接时自动提交事务。默认 false

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.connection-info
properties.description: connection properties on DriverManager.getConnection(url,info)，用 & 分割属性

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.info-sql-threshold
properties.description: printSQL == true时，打印INFO级别的SQL的耗时阈值(ms)。<=0 - 不打印INFO级别SQL，默认 10ms

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.warn-sql-threshold
properties.description: printSQL == true时，打印WARN级别的SQL的耗时阈值(ms)。<=0 - 不打印 WARN 级别SQL，默认 100ms

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.jmx-level
properties.description: 0 - [default] no jmx；1 - manage ConnectionFactory instance；2 - manage PooledConnection instance

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.lazy-init
properties.description: lazy init pool。true: init min connections in Monitor thread, else init in new Hqcp/getConnection() thread, i.e. client thread。默认 false

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.max-pre-statements
properties.description: 池中最多缓存的PreparedStatement数。超过该值的话会close最早未使用的PreparedStatement。取值范围 5 - 200，默认 10

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.max-statements
properties.description: 池中最多缓存的Statement数。超过该值的话会抛SQLException，说明程序存在极不合理的实现，即一个过程中同时创建了太多Statement且没有及时close。取值范围 10 - 1000，默认 100

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.print-sql
properties.description: 记录SQL语句及执行时间。默认 true

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.mask-sql
properties.description: 打印log的时候是否脱敏敏感字段。默认 false

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.sensitive-fields
properties.description: 敏感字段集。条目可带后缀 列名:首:尾（两个非负整数）指定该列的值保留首尾多少位、中间放一份 mask-pattern，如 bank_account:0:4；pin:0:0 表示整值全掩。无后缀的条目沿用全局规则（mask-keep-head / mask-keep-tail）；首尾保留位数按字面值还原转义后的真实字符计。后缀格式不合法（非整数、负数、段数不对）或同一列给了不同后缀时，绑定配置即抛 IllegalArgumentException，应用启动失败（与 init-on-startup 无关）

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.mask-keep-head
properties.description: 脱敏时全局保留的首部位数。mask-keep-head / mask-keep-tail 任一 >= 0 即启用全局首尾保留规则（另一个未设按 0）：值长度 <= 首+尾 时输出 mask-pattern，否则输出 首部 + mask-pattern + 尾部；都未设时沿用默认脱敏算法。默认 -1（未设）

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.mask-keep-tail
properties.description: 脱敏时全局保留的尾部位数，规则见 mask-keep-head。默认 -1（未设）

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.sensitive-fields-exact-match
properties.description: 敏感字段是否精确匹配列名。false：列名包含敏感字段即命中（子串匹配）；true：列名去掉两侧引号后与敏感字段相等才命中。默认 false

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.transaction-mode
properties.description: 默认获取的连接的事务模式。true: 事务模式，即autocommit=false；false: [默认值] 非事务模式，即autocommit=true

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.verbose
properties.description: 记录除SQL语句及执行时间外的其他信息。默认 false

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.use-oracle-implicit-cache
properties.description: Indicates if oracle implicit preparedstatement cache needed

properties.name: spring.datasource.hqcp.password-key
properties.description: 解密password的密钥。未配置时依次取系统属性 / 环境变量 JDBC_SECRET_KEY，仍未配置则回落内置默认密钥（将废弃）
